abstract.text: Integrate Quadrascan to generate 3D models and anthropometric measurements of a subject using a guided, SwiftUI-based scanning flow.

inlineContent.text: Quadrascan SDK exposes a SwiftUI view that interactively guides a person through a process that collects images of them and returns a 3D model and anthropometric measurements of said person. To use the SDK, add it to your project, provide a configuration, and present the scan view. The scan completes with a result object containing output based on your configuration.
Quadrascan requires camera and photo library access. Add these keys to your app’s Info.plist:
Both keys are required for app submission.
